title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Large Language Models with Incoherence-adjusted Semantic Volume
abstract: arXiv:2602.24195v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite their capabilities, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) may produce plausible but erroneous outputs, hindering reliable deployment. Accurate uncertainty metrics could enable escalation of unreliable queries to human experts or larger models for improved performance. However, existing uncertainty metrics have practical constraints, such as being designed only for specific modalities, reliant on external tools, or computationally expensive. We introduce UMPIRE, a training-free uncertainty quantification framework for MLLMs that works efficiently across various input and output modalities without external tools, relying only on the models' own internal modality features. Inspired by Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), UMPIRE computes a novel incoherence-adjusted semantic volume of sampled MLLM responses for a given task instance, which couples semantic embedding dispersion with the quadratic entropy of the responses. translated_title: 基于非相干性调整语义体积的多模态大语言模型不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能力强大，但它们可能产生看似合理实则错误的输出，这阻碍了其可靠部署。准确的不确定性度量可以将不可靠的查询升级给人类专家或更大的模型处理，从而提升性能。然而，现有的不确定性度量存在实际限制，例如仅针对特定模态设计、依赖外部工具或计算成本高昂。我们提出了UMPIRE，这是一个面向多模态大语言模型的免训练不确定性量化框架，它能够在各种输入和输出模态上高效工作，无需外部工具，仅依赖模型自身的内部模态特征。受行列式点过程（DPPs）的启发，UMPIRE针对给定任务实例计算采样得到的MLLM响应的一种新颖的非相干性调整语义体积，该方法将语义嵌入的离散度与响应的二次熵相结合。
tldr: 提出了UMPIRE，一个免训练且无需外部工具的多模态大语言模型不确定性量化框架，其受行列式点过程启发，通过计算新颖的“非相干性调整语义体积”，将语义嵌入离散度与响应二次熵相结合，从而高效支持多种输入输出模态。
en_tdlr: UMPIRE is a training-free uncertainty quantification framework for MLLMs that works efficiently across various modalities without external tools, computing a novel incoherence-adjusted semantic volume inspired by Determinantal Point Processes that couples semantic embedding dispersion with the quadratic entropy of sampled responses.
